faqs.q: Sec. 46-48. - Low income persons as renters.
faqs.a:
The authority may rent or lease dwelling accommodations therein only to persons of
               low income, being persons receiving incomes less than the incomes which, according
               to the determination of the authority, persons must receive to enable them to pay
               the rent necessary to secure safe and sanitary dwelling accommodations within the
               boundaries of the authority, except such dwelling accommodations as are provided by
               the authority or the city.
(Code 1981, § 14-18; Ord. No. 1248, § 8(1)(a), 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-210(1)(a).
